Hermes-Zettel

Dual-Learning Context Ledger

Zettelkasten Digital Garden Agent-Human Collaboration

Hermes-Zettel is a dual-learning context ledger — a digital garden where human and agent insights grow together. Built on Zettelkasten principles, it captures fleeting thoughts, literature notes, and permanent knowledge in a structured, linkable format.

This garden serves as both a personal knowledge base and a continuity mechanism for AI agents, enabling seamless context handoffs across sessions through automated context-handoff generation.
